description: This source file contains an extension to the NodeAppModel class, providing methods for resolving host URLs (particularly for Canvas and A2UI), normalizing URLs for trust comparisons, and managing UI states related to network connectivity and host availability in an iOS application.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURL
methods.description: Asynchronously resolves the URL of the Canvas host by trimming the current URL and ensuring it is valid, then appending a specific path unless the host is a loopback address.

methods.name: _test_resolveA2UIHostURL
methods.description: Test method that calls resolveA2UIHostURL for testing purposes.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURL
methods.description: Resolves the A2UI host URL similarly to resolveCanvasHostURL, but appends a different path and query parameter.

methods.name: normalizeURLForTrustComparison
methods.description: Normalizes a URL string by lowercasing scheme and host, and removing the fragment for consistent trust comparison.

methods.name: showA2UIOnConnectIfNeeded
methods.description: Displays the default A2UI canvas when connecting, ensuring UI updates are performed on the main thread.

methods.name: ensureA2UIReadyWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Ensures that the A2UI is ready, attempting to refresh the node's canvas capability if necessary, and returning an appropriate readiness state.

methods.name: showLocalCanvasOnDisconnect
methods.description: Shows the default canvas when disconnected.

methods.name: resolveA2UIHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the A2UI host URL, refreshing the capability if needed.

methods.name: resolveCanvasHostURLWithCapabilityRefresh
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the canvas host URL, refreshing the capability if initial resolution fails.

methods.name: probeTCP
methods.description: Performs a TCP probe to a given URL's host and port to check connectivity, with a specified timeout.
